# Browseai

Browse.ai allows you to turn any website into an API using its advanced web automation and data extraction tools, enabling easy monitoring and data retrieval from websites.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/browseai/.

## Actions

- **Bulk Run Tasks**: This action allows users to bulk run up to 50,000 tasks using a specified robot.
- **Create Monitor**: This tool creates a new monitor for a specific robot in browse ai.
- **Create Webhook**: This tool creates a new webhook for a browseai robot.
- **Delete a specific monitor**: This tool allows users to delete a specific monitor from their browse ai account.
- **Delete a specific task**: This tool allows you to delete a specific task in browseai by its task id.
- **Get Robot Tasks** (read-only): This tool retrieves all tasks associated with a specific robot in browse ai.
- **Get Robots List** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all robots under your account in browse ai.
- **Get Task Details** (read-only): This tool retrieves detailed information about a specific task in browse ai by its task id.
- **Run Robot**: This tool allows you to trigger the execution of a browseai robot on demand.
